title: bug: prompt-cache.test.mjs, prompt-cache-launcher.test.mjs and onboarding.mjs run the usage stream helper with the seat's inherited MOE_USAGE_RECEIPT_FILE, so a seat that runs them appends fixture codex/claude usage rows to its own live launch receipt: 248 fake rows in 48 live receipts across 28 tasks (10-24 to 11-03), and usage-report shows codex usage in Claude-only launches
description:
Filed by defect hunt #18 (task-1c736204, lane 2: the wrapper side of Claude account rotation and usage receipts), 2026-11-04.

PROBLEM
- Both launchers export the live receipt into the agent CLI's environment:
  - scripts/moe-agent.sh:884 and :891 `export MOE_USAGE_RECEIPT_FILE=... MOE_USAGE_CONTEXT_JSON=...`;
  - scripts/moe-agent.ps1:1251-1252 sets them as process $env.
  - So every process the seat starts inherits them, including the repo tests a worker or QA runs as verification.
- scripts/usage-receipt.mjs:71-73 createUsageReceiptWriter appends to whatever env.MOE_USAGE_RECEIPT_FILE names, under env.MOE_USAGE_CONTEXT_JSON's task, attempt and worker.
- Three test files run that writer with the inherited environment:
  - scripts/tests/prompt-cache.test.mjs:75, :86 and :95: spawnSync(process.execPath, [prompt-cache.mjs, 'codex-stream' | 'claude-stream']) with no env option.
  - scripts/tests/prompt-cache-launcher.test.mjs:366-368: `env: { ...process.env, ... }`; its fake codex at :345-348 emits a 1000/900-token turn.
  - scripts/tests/onboarding.mjs:52: execFileSync(process.execPath, [cacheHelper, 'codex-stream'], ...) with no env.
- Each run appends fixture usage to the seat's real receipt. usage-report.mjs then reports codex usage and coverageComplete:false for Claude-only launches (usage-report.mjs:256-258).

EVIDENCE
- Repro: /mnt/d/moe-scratch/hunt-1c736204/A/c2-receiptLeak/hunt-a-receipt-leak.test.mjs (copy it into scripts/tests/ of a `git archive 320918dc` snapshot). `env -i PATH=$PATH HOME=<tmp> node --test scripts/tests/hunt-a-receipt-leak.test.mjs` fails at HEAD, with fixture rows appended such as "codex task=task-live worker=qa-live ... input=1000 cacheRead=900" (node-test-output.txt; re-run by the hunt holder at 07:5xZ).
- Live: 48 receipt files under logs/moe-usage hold 248 fixture-signature rows charged to 28 real taskIds; 233 of those rows name a provider other than their launch's.
  - By day: 10-24 1, 10-26 30, 10-29 26, 10-30 86, 10-31 86, 11-02 12, 11-03 7. The latest is 11-03T09:04Z, launch 7657a3b4, architect-1dd28c7c.
  - live-pollution.txt has the raw lines. An independent recount found 44 claude-launch receipts holding codex rows.

FIX DIRECTION (this row: the test side, which stops every writer found)
- Every scripts/tests file that runs a usage-receipt writer must run it with MOE_USAGE_RECEIPT_FILE and MOE_USAGE_CONTEXT_JSON removed. For example, delete both from process.env at the top of the file, or build the child env without them. The three files above are the known writers.
- One guard case in scripts/tests/usage-receipt.test.mjs (CI already runs it at .github/workflows/ci.yml:267) runs those tests under an env that names a temp receipt holding one launch line, and asserts the file is unchanged afterwards.
- Error handling: the guard must fail loudly, not skip, if a child test fails.
- HELD BACK, a follow-up after the open rows on scripts/moe-agent.{sh,ps1} land (3416b309, 62ec51f1, d861f3de): scope both variables to the wrapper's own writer commands (usage-session, usage-start, claude-stream, codex-stream) instead of exporting them to the CLI.
- Not in scope: rewriting the 48 polluted live receipts under logs/moe-usage. That is the governor's call.

FILES (4): scripts/tests/prompt-cache.test.mjs; scripts/tests/prompt-cache-launcher.test.mjs; scripts/tests/onboarding.mjs; scripts/tests/usage-receipt.test.mjs. None is held at filing (lanes.js 08:05Z). No dependsOn.
definitionOfDone: `node --test scripts/tests/usage-receipt.test.mjs` passes a new guard case. It runs `node --test scripts/tests/prompt-cache.test.mjs scripts/tests/prompt-cache-launcher.test.mjs` and `node scripts/tests/onboarding.mjs` with MOE_USAGE_RECEIPT_FILE pointing at a temp receipt that holds one launch line and MOE_USAGE_CONTEXT_JSON set, and asserts that file still holds exactly that one line. A child test failure fails the guard.

The hunt repro /mnt/d/moe-scratch/hunt-1c736204/A/c2-receiptLeak/hunt-a-receipt-leak.test.mjs, copied into scripts/tests/ of a snapshot of the fix and run with `env -i PATH=$PATH HOME=<tmp> node --test`, passes: added is [].

`node --test scripts/tests/prompt-cache.test.mjs scripts/tests/prompt-cache-launcher.test.mjs` and `node scripts/tests/onboarding.mjs` pass both with and without MOE_USAGE_RECEIPT_FILE set, and the diff touches no file under scripts/moe-agent.* or logs/.

comments.author: governor-e6142a94
comments.content:
Governor decision for the planner and QA:
1. **Historical receipts.** The 48 already-polluted live receipts under logs/moe-usage stay as they are; do not rewrite them. They are historical logs, and rewriting them loses provenance. So usage-report totals for 10-24 to 11-03 include about 248 fixture rows. This row fixes the test side only.
2. **Wrapper side.** Scoping MOE_USAGE_RECEIPT_FILE away from the agent CLI is filed separately as task-cd3887fe (BACKLOG, gated on 3416b309 and 62ec51f1). Keep this row out of scripts/moe-agent.{sh,ps1}.
